viewing_check: Open the case back: look for hallmark/carat stamp (9K, 375, 750, 18K) versus 'gold plated' or 'rolled gold' / steel back, read the calibre (e.g. 485, 620, 625) and serial, check the movement runs, dial condition and that the box is the matching Omega box. Photograph the case back and lugs.
